title: ACAB: All Cops Are Brainwashed
description:
In this erotic hypnosis roleplay, you’ll be the arresting officer who’s shoved me into the back seat of your squad car. As you drive me along the dark roads late at night, I explain just how I ended up in this situation… some sexual escapades that went too far is all, officer.

And as you listen to my hypnotic voice, and the highway hypnosis kicks in, you might find it hard to stop listening. You might even find yourself getting aroused by my story, and your loyalties might begin to shift from your duties, to me.

By the time I’m finished, you’ll be so deeply hypnotized and aroused that you’ll be following my orders. Even if they might get you in trouble. Because you like to follow orders, officer. All cops are trained for that. Brainwashed to do it. Isn’t that right?

Art by Kayriko.
